era_envelope.default_vfx_ceiling_is_a_default_not_a_c: There is no trilogy fx_max. `default_vfx_ceiling` is a DEFAULT: the FX level to assume when nothing says otherwise. Exceeding it is NOT a breach and is not reported as one. The fx band derived from this trilogy's books is FX1-FX3, recorded here for reference only.

environment_envelope.derivation: Union of the three book envelopes beneath this trilogy (B04, B05, B06), each itself a union of its three act bands: min of mins, max of maxes, per axis. No judgement was applied to any value. Regenerate rather than hand-edit.
